faqs.question: How do I find my position?
faqs.before:
Bedrock: Turn on the "Show Coordinates" option in the game settings screen.
Java: Press F3 in-game and note the X and Z coordinates (the first and last numbers).
faqs.after: Use the X and Z values for Player X and Player Z in the app. Your height (Y) is not needed for the search.

faqs.question: How do I find my world seed?
faqs.before:
In Bedrock/PE: Press Pause > Settings > Game, then scroll down until you see "Seed".
In Java: Type /seed in chat with the required permissions to display your world seed.
faqs.after: Copy the complete seed into the World seed field. Keep a note of it so you can use the same world again.

faqs.question: Which Minecraft versions are supported?
faqs.before: The Find Ore version menu lists the Java versions available for searching. Select the version that matches your world before you start.

faqs.question: Is this app safe to use?
faqs.before: Ore Scout works alongside your game. It does not change your world or ask for your game account password.
